title: [PM seat] domain:ui · seat 2 — 🟢 os-steve · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 2**, opened on the maintainer's word to add a seat to the lane (「你现在就可以增加席位啊」, project chat, 2026-10-26). Seat 1 is #25966. No `domain:ui` seat-2 post existed in the `pm:seat` index (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (Claude Code project "objectstack ui", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发(席位 2)") · `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup` · seated 2026-10-26.
- **File area (split with seat 1; rebalanced on the maintainer's word 「你应该合理安排分工」, 2026-10-26):** seat 2 = `ui/packages/` plugin-list, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-view, fields, plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-timeline, plugin-tree, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report; plus auth (`ui/packages/auth`, console / app-shell auth pages), the Setup / admin pages (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/**`), marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 (#25966) = every other `domain:ui` path (i18n locales, `components` form, Studio / designer, chat / AI build, tech-debt). A card spanning both goes to the seat owning its main landing package. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#2`.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** read #25966's queue too — one card per file across both seats. Seat 2 holds: `plugin-map/ObjectMap.tsx` (#25889) · `plugin-dashboard/DatasetWidget.tsx` (#25970) · `plugin-grid/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx` (#25942) · `plugin-detail/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` + `renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts` (#25959) · `fields/src/index.tsx` `UserCellRenderer` + `fields/widgets/UserField.tsx` + `plugin-grid/relationalMetaKeys.ts` (#25937) · `fields/widgets/LookupField.tsx` (#25860) · `core` state-machine helper, `plugin-form` form arms, `plugin-kanban` (#25933) · console auth pages + `RegisterPage.tsx` (#25886; #25885 next) · `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.shellLeave-13231.test.tsx` (#26096, queue-flake anchor). Waiting: #25994 (`ObjectGrid.tsx` split) until the landing train drains; #25883/#25884 on seat 1's #25897 (PR #25998); #25895 on #25888; #25891 deferred (needs the locale packs); ⛔ `plugin-detail/DetailView.tsx` held by seat 1's #25877. `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` — ⛔ out of bounds for every ui card for now (maintainer's word in the project).
- **Landing order (since #26120, 2026-10-26T13:49Z — one sdui record per registry package):** a PR enqueues once every earlier PR sharing a registry package with it has MERGED (agreed with seat 1). plugin-grid #26030 → #26033 → #26050 · plugin-form #26042 ✓ → #26033 · fields #26062 → #26050 · plugin-detail #25998 → #26053 → #26060 → #26055 · i18n #26045 → #26040 → #26044 → #26048 → #26055 → #25921 · plugin-dashboard #26027 free. A PR that moves `sdui.manifest.json` itself stays globally serial. Patch round: merge main → take main's `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` → `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` → build Console.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer, project chat):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR is opened on the objectui repository; a change to a package inside the sdui registry closure (core, components, fields, i18n, react, types, the plugin-* packages …; not app-shell, layout or apps/console) re-records `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#2` + `head:claude/` PRs.
- **Wall:** none.
